prompt:

Preserve the precise kitten identity, face, fur markings, expression, pose, silhouette, anatomy, linework, object shapes, sizes, positions, entire composition, plain paper, existing white margins, canvas size and exact 4:3 aspect ratio. Do not add, remove, shrink, move or redraw objects. Keep the current clean cute cel-anime illustration with thin clear lines, flat fills and simple pale shadows. Do not introduce paper texture, grain, brown/yellow aged wash, oil paint, watercolor, blur, haze, text, border, UI, signature or watermark. The background and existing paper margins stay clean near-white, not tinted.
Palette replacement: Mint rainy-night palette: change the main pink door/blanket/pencil surfaces to pale mint green, use cool clean white and a little desaturated blue for secondary accents, and replace warm sunset-yellow decorations with soft cool pale-blue/white accents. The kitten remains very pale silver-gray with pink inner ears/nose and exactly the same dark eyes.
